name: Suzui Haruka
source:
A gifted girl who entered the school on a scholarship and served as the representative at the entrance ceremony.

Naturally, her grades are the best, but she doesn't brag about it and has a humble and gentle personality.
She doesn't make enemies and is liked by everyone, so she is always at the center of the class.

She is aware that her roommate and best friend Mizuki is disliked in class, and she hopes that she can somehow find a way to get along with everyone.

Her family runs a hospital, so she wants to go to medical school and take over the family business.

[Translated from the [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20121105072348/http://slpr.sakura.ne.jp/DEEP2/]the official site,archived[/url]]
